subject: Law Department Supplemental Appropriation and Audit Agreement
overview: The Council approved a one-month supplemental appropriation for the Law Department following an agreement with the Mayor’s administration to initiate an independent audit of city legal spending.

items.title: Supplemental Appropriation for Law Department
items.summary: Approved a revised supplemental appropriation of $62,507.63 to fund Law Department operations through November and cover legal costs for the upcoming election. The approval followed an agreement with the administration to solicit quotes for an independent audit of legal spending and post the vacant city solicitor position.
